title: Design System: The AI Study Bible

display.purpose: Rare route-level and public-facing headings only.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Existing compact control lift; use only for transient interaction feedback in new work.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating menus, popovers, and compact transient panels.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and compact reveal transitions.

motion.name: header-reveal
motion.purpose: Sticky header hide and return behavior.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant local action, compact and direct.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background:hsl(var(--primary)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font:500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:hsl(var(--primary)/.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--ring)/.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:hsl(var(--primary)/.82); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action with an explicit but quiet boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background:hsl(var(--background)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:hsl(var(--accent)); color:hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:hsl(var(--ring)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--ring)/.5); } .ds-btn-outline:active { background:hsl(var(--accent)/.8); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis utility action that appears on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background:transparent; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:hsl(var(--accent)); color:hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--ring)/.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background:hsl(var(--accent)/.8); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact field with a clear keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-width:0; height:36px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background:transparent; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:400 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; transition:border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); opacity:1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:hsl(var(--foreground)/.28); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:hsl(var(--ring)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--ring)/.5); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Study Card
components.description: A bounded supporting surface for study tools, not a default page scaffold.
components.html:
Related passage

Study context stays close to the Scripture it supports.
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:24px; padding:24px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) + 4px); background:hsl(var(--card)); color:hsl(var(--card-foreground)); font:400 16px/1.75 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0; color:hsl(var(--card-foreground)); font:600 20px/1.25 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin:0; max-width:70ch; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color:hsl(var(--ring)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--ring)/.35); }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: A restrained sticky header whose controls recede around the reading task.
components.html: The AI Study BibleReadStudy
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; min-height:72px; padding:4px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background:hsl(var(--background)/.8); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right:auto; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav a { border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); padding:8px 10px; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { background:hsl(var(--accent)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--ring)/.5); }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a quiet margin beside Scripture: present when a reader reaches for context, otherwise visually recessive. It is quiet, focused, and unhurried, with familiar controls and measured density that protect long-form reading. The system is refined and restrained rather than ornamental. Midnight Ink anchors actions and structure; Insight Cyan and Annotation Magenta are scarce semantic signals, never ambient decoration. The product must not feel like a flashy AI demo: glows, gradients, constant motion, and AI theatrics are prohibited when they compete with Scripture.
keyCharacteristics: Scripture owns the largest, calmest surface.
Study tools appear progressively and remain close to the passage they explain.
Controls use familiar shapes, compact radii, and explicit focus states.
Light and dark themes preserve hierarchy rather than changing personality.
Motion communicates state within 150–250 ms; it never stages the page.

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Insight Cyan and Annotation Magenta together occupy no more than 10% of a product screen; they identify state or meaning, never atmosphere.

rules.name: The Reading Field Rule
rules.body: Scripture sits on the quietest available neutral. Never place long-form passage text over a gradient, glow, image, or translucent surface.

rules.name: The One Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter carries every task-oriented surface. Goldman is forbidden in buttons, form labels, navigation labels, tables, and dense study controls.

rules.name: The Adjustable Text Rule
rules.body: User-selected Scripture size changes content typography without scaling surrounding controls or destabilizing layout.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Static cards, fields, and buttons do not combine a border with a persistent shadow. Choose tonal separation or a border; elevation appears only when behavior requires it.

dos: Do keep Scripture on Reading White or Night Surface with WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
Do use Midnight Ink for the dominant local action and reserve saturated accents for semantic state.
Do keep task controls in Inter at 0.875rem–1rem with visible keyboard focus.
Do expose deeper study tools progressively beside the passage that gives them context.
Do preserve scalable Scripture type, comfortable line length, spacing, and theme controls.
donts: Don't make the product feel like a flashy AI demo; glows, gradients, constant motion, and AI theatrics that compete with Scripture are prohibited.
Don't use gradient text, animated gradient buttons, pulsing decoration, bouncing controls, or orchestrated page-load sequences.
Don't combine a one-pixel border with a persistent wide shadow on the same static element.
Don't use Goldman for navigation, form labels, buttons, data, or repeated product headings.
Don't rely on Insight Cyan or Annotation Magenta as decoration or as the only carrier of meaning.
Don't hide common reading and navigation actions behind unfamiliar custom affordances.
